{{Quote|I am Shaey Kayr, Kashyyyk Explorer extraordinaire! I know everything about Kashyyyk... and more! You have questions? Shaey Kayr has answers!|Shaey Kayr|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
'''Shaey Kayr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] present on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] world of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. He was an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] and had begun his trek across Kashyyyk by first taking in the sights of the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]].

==Behind the scenes==
Shaey Kayr appears in the ''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'' expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']]. His purpose is to give the player general information about the major points of interest within the Kkowir Forest.
